data.title: The sword from Púchovská skala has been stolen!
data.excerpt: A replica of a Celtic iron sword, forged by the artist-blacksmith Pavol Rác for the rest area on Púchovská skala, lasted barely two months there. A few days before Christmas an unknown culprit laboriously sawed it off its mounting on the rock, and the site lost what was perhaps its greatest attraction.
data.metaTitle: The sword from Púchovská skala has been stolen
data.metaDescription: A replica of a Celtic sword of the Púchov culture by the blacksmith Pavol Rác was stolen from Púchovská skala just before Christmas, after barely two months.

mediaTexts.alt: A Celtic iron sword with its hilt, lying on a stone boulder

children.text: The iron Celtic sword lasted barely two months on Púchovská skala. A few days before Christmas Eve an unknown culprit made off with it. The replica of a Celtic sword of the kind made and used by the people of the Púchov culture, who also had their seat on Púchovská skala, was forged by the artist-blacksmith Pavol Rác. The sword was to be part of a rest area which the civic association MŔTVA KOSŤ has now been building for the fifth year.

Members of the association, together with the blacksmith Rác, installed the sword on a piece of rock at the end of October. The object was fixed in such a way that it could not easily be stolen. The sword did not, however, serve the eyes of the tourists who visit Púchovská skala for long. In the run-up to Christmas the resourceful unknown culprit came to the place equipped with tools and laboriously sawed the sword off its mounting on the rock.

Several hours of hard work in the smithy were wasted for the author of the replica. The initiative of Rác and the members of MŔTVA KOSŤ, to give people pleasure selflessly, came to nothing. Púchovská skala, an important historical place which has entered more than merely regional history, has thus lost what was perhaps its greatest attraction. And all that for the vain greed of a thief who wanted a masterly piece of smithing just for himself.

blocks.alt: The sword from Púchovská skala has been stolen!

children.text: Besides the sword, MŔTVA KOSŤ this year also installed new benches, a table, a bicycle rack and litter bins in the rest area on Púchovská skala. Fortunately, nothing has happened to those. The activists of Mŕtva kosť, in cooperation with the civic association Puchovo dedičstvo, have also created an information website,
, which gives those interested comprehensive information about the rock and about the so-called Púchov culture in a clear form.

Mŕtva kosť wants to bring the project of building the rest area to a definitive close next year. On the occasion of the spring equinox, Púchovská skala will again be the venue of the international event the Celtic Telegraph, which the association organises regularly. Sadly, probably now without the sword, which at least symbolically referred to the Celts.
If you have any knowledge concerning the theft of the sword, write to the association's e-mail address: info@mrtvakost.sk or, if you prefer, to our Hradiská address orgon333@gmail.com
